metadata.description: Personal Claude Code marketplace: one /task workflow (create, start and end, with sub-sessions per item) plus stack check plugins (frontend, server incl. Supabase).

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Backlog-driven work loop as one skill: /task create, /task start, /task end. Claude invokes it on its own when you ask to add, start or finish a backlog item. create and start open a sub-session by default (start in its own worktree on a w/ branch), where you answer questions and approve; end runs in that work session. --here, or no session tool, runs it in the current session. Scales planning to task size, verifies once before done, and reviews with code-review plus the stack reviewers of enabled plugins and the design-reviewer agent when a screen changed. A Stop hook re-runs the verify command when an item is marked done, also after another Stop hook such as /goal has blocked. Web and server ports are split per item.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend checks for /task start and /task end (Svelte and React references), the frontend-reviewer agent, and the frontend-evaluator agent that verifies acceptance criteria in the browser.

plugins.name: server
plugins.description: Backend and Supabase checks for /task start and /task end (any server language and Supabase: migrations, API contract, RLS, keys) and the api-reviewer and supabase-reviewer agents.
